messages:
olivia: heads-up — seeing nvme SMART warnings on a subset of ap-southeast1 preemptible nodes. spike in reallocated sectors + io_time, but our per-disk telemetry is missing for ~30% of nodes. saw the alert at 08:12 UTC and provisioning delays coincided.

sre-bot: [ALERT] nvme_iops_error_rate HIGH on cluster-gpu-ap-southeast1 (72 hosts) — triggered 2026-03-19T08:12Z · alert-6887-io

raj: can you paste the alert id and a sample node? i saw GPU launch queue growth and a couple GPU attaches failing around that time.

olivia: alert id: alert-6887-io. sample node gnode-ap-0345. dmesg shows repeated: "nvme0: Write CRC error, namespace 1". when I look at metrics the exporter returns NaN for per-disk SMART metrics: "nvme_smart_reallocated{device="nvme0"}=NaN".

kevin: we rolled kernel 5.15.0-rt across that region last week to reduce tail latency. that image change also trimmed packages. did we remove nvme-cli/smartctl from the node image? @dena did the node image update land yesterday?

den a: I updated the AMI build — I removed smartd to save ~40MB and left nvme-cli normally. digging now: systemd unit for smartd is masked in the AMI by an image optimization step (oops). also noticed disk-exporter uses /sys/class/nvme for health, but on some of our ephemeral overlay setups the device naming moved to /dev/nvme* aliases so the exporter fell back to empty.

dena: quick mitigation plan:
- unmask smartd and re-enable it on the image
- ensure nvme-cli present in AMI
- add exporter fallback to use `nvme-cli --health-log` if /sys entries missing

Example one-line canary patch we can run on pool nodes:
```bash
curl -fsSL https://internal-infra.s3/patches/6887-nvme-telemetry.sh | sudo bash
# patch installs nvme-cli, unmask smartd, restarts node-exporter
```

raj: can we target only the preemptible GPU pool as a canary? we should avoid mass reboots. Also immediate mitigation: throttle batch worker IOPS by reducing job chunking. set env REDWOOD_BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 for ap-southeast1 staging for now.

kevin: creating a canary rollout to 5 nodes in ap-southeast1-preemptible. I'll add a prometheus relabel to capture nvme serial and mark missing as 0 so we can track the gap. launching deploy job now.

sre-bot: deploy started by kevin — job deploy-20260319-6887 (5 hosts)

olivia: also schedule an offline background scrub/trim to clear pending reallocated sectors if controllers permit. not confident trim was running on those preemptible images after the overlay rename.

den a: canary finished: deploy succeeded on 5 nodes after ~12m. telemetry for gnode-ap-0345 now shows `nvme_smart_reallocated=3` (was NaN before). smartd logs show health poll every 6h now.

raj: nice. holding larger GPU launches for 30m and throttling autoscaler to avoid overcommitting ephemeral drives. i'll watch the GPU attach failures and queue length.

kevin: rolling to remaining preemptible pool in 2 hours if no regressions. pushed exporter fallback to eng-infra/disk-exporter repo and created PR to enable fallback parsing and nvme-cli path scanning.

olivia: follow-ups for the storage / infra backlog:
1) roll patch to all preemptible pools (2hr canary window)
2) add exporter fallback & unit tests in disk-exporter
3) enable daily fstrim on preemptible nodes via cron (check overlay compatibility)
4) create runbook for nvme telemetry gaps and an automated remediation job that installs nvme-cli + restarts smartd when metrics are NaN
5) ticket to storage team to review wear patterns across instance sizes (we're seeing a higher reallocated rate on smaller instances)

kevin: can we also add a short-term scheduler change to reduce concurrent attach operations across a single host? that would smooth IOPS spikes during scale-ups.

olivia: good call. throttle attach concurrency to 4 per node during rollout window.

raj: I'll update autoscaler config and monitor attach latency.

olivia: thanks everyone. will close after full roll completes and a 1-day stability window. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: deploy completed — job deploy-20260319-6887 (5 hosts) — all checks green

olivia: canary stable @ +1h, rolling now. will post final summary to #incidents if anything escalates. :heart:
